Forwards time their swings to receive the puck with speed.

title: Center Ice Figure Eight One Touches
description: An advanced one-touch passing and footwork drill at center ice. One player skates a figure-eight around two cones while continuously exchanging one-touch passes with four stationary players positioned around the neutral-zone faceoff dots, then attacks for a shot.
coaching_points: Active player faces the puck at all times.
Keep the feet moving through every figure-eight turn.
Use one-touch passes whenever possible.
Maintain awareness of all four passing options while navigating the cones.

title: Cyclone Drill
description: A half-ice passing and skating drill built around a tight circular route. Players move through the middle with constant puck exchanges, work their edges and timing around the central pattern, then finish the sequence by attacking the net.
coaching_points: Keep the feet moving throughout the circular pattern.
Make firm passes while changing direction.
Stay aware of the next passing option before receiving the puck.
Exit the pattern with speed and finish the shot in stride.

title: Cycle Down Low with Shot
description: A three-forward offensive-zone cycling drill. Players cycle the puck down low while keeping their feet moving and maintaining one forward in the high slot. On the coach's whistle, the next puck carrier finds the high player and the other two forwards drive the net for a rebound.
coaching_points: Keep the feet moving through every cycle exchange.
Maintain one forward high as protection against a turnover.
Move the puck to the high slot immediately on the whistle.
Both low forwards crash the net and compete for the rebound.

title: Neutral Zone Attack with Speed #3
description: The third neutral-zone speed progression teaches an attacker to read a large defensive gap. The forward receives the puck with speed, sells an outside attack at the blue line, cuts back toward the middle and finishes with a shot from the slot.
coaching_points: Catch the pass at full speed.
Sell the outside drive before attacking the middle.
Keep the head up through the direction change.
Accelerate into the slot and release the shot quickly.

title: Neutral Zone Attack With Speed #4
description: The fourth neutral-zone speed progression adds a second player. After making the initial pass, the second player sprints to the far post while the puck carrier attacks wide and can either pass across the crease or shoot short side.
coaching_points: Puck carrier attacks the zone with speed and keeps the feet moving.
Second player drives directly to the far post with the stick available.
Read the goalie before deciding between the pass and short-side shot.
Time the net drive so the second player arrives as the puck reaches the scoring area.

title: Neutral Zone Attack with Speed #5
description: The fifth neutral-zone speed progression again uses a second player driving the far post. The puck carrier attacks off the same middle-driving move while the second player arrives at the net ready for a pass, rebound, screen or tip.
coaching_points: Drive the far post hard with the stick on the ice.
Stop at the net instead of skating through the scoring area.
Puck carrier attacks with speed and creates the shot or rebound opportunity.
Second player should be ready to screen, tip or collect a rebound.

title: Swap Drill
description: A full-ice timing drill run from both sides. Two players pass while moving toward the blue line, then exchange roles across the ice so the inside player receives a pass from the opposite corner and attacks wide while the support player fills the slot.
coaching_points: Start both sides together so the cross-ice timing stays synchronized.
Inside player cannot get ahead of the opposite-side passing option.
Attack wide after receiving the cross-ice pass.
Support player arrives in the slot as a legitimate scoring option.

title: Chip & Receive
description: A neutral-zone chip-entry drill. The puck carrier times the route to receive a pass near the red line, chips the puck off the boards into open space past pressure at the blue line, and a supporting player coming through the middle retrieves it for a scoring chance.
coaching_points: Time the first route so the puck arrives at or just after the red line.
Use touch on the chip instead of simply firing the puck deep.
Place the chip into space where the supporting player can skate onto it.
Middle support attacks with speed and turns the chip into an immediate scoring chance.

title: Shoot & Go
description: A competitive 2 on 0 finishing game. Two players make as many passes as possible before the hash marks, one shoots, and then both race around cones to a loose puck near center ice. The race winner earns a breakaway chance if the first 2 on 0 did not score.
coaching_points: Move the puck quickly on the initial 2 on 0.
Shoot by the hash marks instead of overpassing.
Accelerate immediately into the race after the first shot.
Use the scoring requirement to keep the competition meaningful.

title: Wildcat One-Time Drill
description: A quick half-ice passing and one-timer drill. A forward moves the puck to the defense, the defense makes a hard return pass across the zone, and the shooter times a route out of the corner to arrive in a one-time shooting position.
coaching_points: Passes should be hard and accurate.
Shooter times the route so the puck arrives in the shooting window.
Set the feet and stick early for the one-timer.
Goalie tracks the lateral puck movement before the shot.

title: Wildcat One-Timer Drill - Variation #1
description: A Wildcat one-timer progression that adds defense movement. The defense receives a pass, skates around a cone, returns the puck, transitions backward to the blue line and then opens up to find a forward timing into the slot for a one-time shot.
coaching_points: Defense keeps the feet moving through the cone and backward transition.
Exchange the puck quickly without overhandling.
Shooter times the slot route instead of arriving early.
Final pass should lead the shooter into the one-timer.

title: Wildcat One-Timer Drill - Variation #3
description: A power-play style one-timer progression. The puck moves from the forward to the defense at the point, back down the wall, then immediately across to a forward timing into the slot for a one-time finish.
coaching_points: Move the puck quickly from low to high and back down the wall.
Wall player delivers the final pass without holding the puck.
Shooter times the route to arrive outside the hash marks in a scoring window.
Follow the one-timer to the net for a rebound.

title: 3 on 0 Regroup on Whistle
description: A full-ice transition drill that begins with a simple breakout. Once the forwards cross the red line, the coach's whistle triggers a turnover-style regroup: the puck is dumped to the opposite corner, the defense retrieves, and the forwards reorganize before attacking 3 on 0.
coaching_points: Forwards stay available underneath the puck during the regroup.
Defense retrieves with urgency and faces up ice before making the first pass.
React immediately to the whistle as if possession has changed.
Attack the final 3 on 0 with proper width and puck support.

title: Open Up Double Pass
description: A full-ice passing warm-up run from four neutral-zone lines. Players pass across the ice, skate through the middle while opening their hips to stay facing the puck, receive the return pass and then attack the net for a shot.
coaching_points: Open the body so the puck stays in view while crossing center ice.
Present the stick as a target for the return pass.
Keep the feet moving through the entire exchange.
Finish with a shot in stride and then clear the shooting lane.

title: Neutral Zone Offense Swing
description: A neutral-zone transition drill that starts with a soft puck to the boards. The defense pivots back, retrieves and moves the puck D-to-D, while the forwards time their routes so one receives the outlet at speed and the second drives the far post.
coaching_points: Defense retrieves with the head up and uses the partner underneath as support.
F1 cannot get ahead of the puck; time the swing for a flat pass.
Receive the outlet at full speed before the red line.
Puck carrier attacks the dot while the second forward drives the far post.

title: Neutral Zone Offense Chip
description: A neutral-zone transition and chip-entry drill. The defense retrieves a soft puck and chips it off the boards into open space for a forward arriving with speed, while a second forward drives through the middle to create a far-post option.
coaching_points: Defense faces up ice before making the chip.
Place the chip into space instead of simply rimming it away.
Forward times the route to skate onto the puck at speed.
Attack off the wall with speed and read the shot versus far-post pass.

title: Neutral Zone Offense Double Chip
description: A double-chip neutral-zone entry. The defense retrieves and chips the puck to the first forward along the wall. That forward carries toward the middle to create a new angle, chips the puck into space for the second forward swinging into the zone, then drives the far post.
coaching_points: First chip must lead the forward into space.
F1 carries toward the middle to improve the angle for the second chip.
Second forward times the swing to receive the chip at speed.
After moving the puck, F1 drives the far post as a scoring option.

title: Breakout Backcheck Drill
description: A full-ice breakout and backcheck drill. The defense carries around the net and makes a breakout pass to the forward. On a second whistle the backchecker releases, the forward moves the puck to a defenseman at center ice, and the backchecker works to disrupt the return pass and scoring chance.
coaching_points: Breakout defenseman moves the puck in stride.
Forward moves the puck to the middle option quickly after the breakout.
Backchecker takes away the return lane instead of chasing from directly behind.
Forward stays available for the return pass and attacks immediately if it arrives.

title: Moose Simple Timing Drill #1
description: A neutral-zone timing drill focused on receiving the outlet at full speed. One defenseman receives from a partner while skating backward, transitions forward toward the middle and finds F1 crossing center ice. F2 curls back while facing the puck, then drives the near post for a pass or rebound.
coaching_points: D1 keeps the feet moving through the backward-to-forward transition.
F1 times the route so the pass arrives at full speed without getting ahead of the play.
F2 stays facing the puck during the curl and then sprints to the near post.
Puck carrier attacks wide with speed and reads shot versus pass.

title: Moose Simple Timing 2 on 1
description: A neutral-zone timing progression that develops into a full-ice 2 on 1. D1 receives from D2 while skating backward, transitions forward and finds F1 at speed. D2 transitions backward to defend while F2 curls outside, stays facing the puck and drives the near post.
coaching_points: F1 times the route to receive the puck at full speed without getting ahead of the play.
D1 keeps the feet moving through the backward-to-forward transition.
D2 establishes a playable gap immediately after making the pass.
F2 stays facing the puck and drives the near post for a pass or rebound.

title: Boston Give & Gos
description: A half-ice forward skill drill built around constant foot movement, passing and shooting. The active forward takes an initial pass for a shot, circles for a give-and-go, attacks for a second shot, then moves the puck to the opposite corner and spins off the wall for one final return pass into the slot.
coaching_points: Keep the feet moving through every pass and shot.
Face the passer during each give-and-go exchange.
Explode off the boards into the slot instead of gliding.
Rotate positions immediately so the drill keeps flowing.

title: 2 on 0 Flow
description: A full-ice 2 on 0 flow drill emphasizing passing in stride and net drive. Two forwards initiate passes with stationary players, swing through neutral ice with their feet moving, receive a cross-ice pass near the red line and continue together on a 2 on 0.
coaching_points: Receive every pass in stride.
Keep the feet moving through the neutral-zone swing.
Use clean cross-ice timing so the puck arrives near the red line.
Attack the final 2 on 0 with width and a hard net drive.

title: Ring Around 1 on 1
description: A full-ice 1 on 1 that works winger wall retrievals and defensive transition. F1 moves the puck D-to-D for a point shot while simultaneously ringing a second puck around the boards to F2. F2 controls the rim and then attacks D1 in a full-ice 1 on 1.
coaching_points: Winger gets to the wall early and controls the rim cleanly.
Defense takes the first shot and immediately transitions to defend.
Attacker exits the wall with speed after gaining control.
Defender establishes the gap early before the rush reaches the blue line.

title: Ring Around 2 on 1
description: A 2 on 1 progression from the Ring Around 1 on 1. F1 initiates a D-to-D point shot and rims a second puck to F2. F2 controls the wall puck and returns it to F1, then both forwards attack D1 together in a full-ice 2 on 1.
coaching_points: F2 controls the rim before moving the puck back to F1.
F1 joins the rush immediately after receiving the wall pass.
Defense transitions from the point shot into gap control without delay.
Use width on the 2 on 1 and force the defender to choose between puck and pass.

title: High Slot Figure Eights (Forwards)
description: A high-slot figure-eight drill for puck feel, edge control and passing readiness. The forward uses tight control turns around two cones while exchanging as many passes as possible with a stationary passer, then receives a puck in the high slot for a shot.
coaching_points: Use tight controlled turns around both cones.
Keep the stick on the ice and remain ready for a pass at all times.
Maintain puck awareness while the feet continue moving.
Progress to pivots around the cones while always facing the passer.

title: 1, 2, 3 on 3 Down Low
description: A progressive down-low possession game that starts 1 on 1, becomes 2 on 2 on the second whistle, and becomes 3 on 3 on the third. The forwards must protect and maintain possession until all three players have joined, then attack for a scoring chance.
coaching_points: Forwards protect the puck and maintain possession before the final whistle.
New players enter immediately and support the existing battle.
Defenders stay goal-side and communicate as the numbers increase.
After the third whistle, turn possession into a scoring chance quickly.

title: Chip and Chase
description: A competitive full-ice chase drill. The first player carries a puck around the top of the circle, shoots and continues around. The second player chips a new puck off the boards, then pursues the first player around the cones as both race back toward the net.
coaching_points: Match players of similar speed and strength to keep the race competitive.
Finish the first shot and immediately continue the route at speed.
Place the chip so it can be pursued without killing the pace of the drill.
The chasing player skates through the pursuit and pressures from behind.

title: Vancouver 1 on 1
description: A defense transition drill that quickly turns into a neutral-zone turnover and 1 on 1. The defense receives a pass while skating backward, transitions forward to create a passing angle and moves the puck to F1 for a shot; as soon as that pass is made, F2 attacks the same defenseman in the opposite direction.
coaching_points: Defense controls the puck while moving backward before transitioning forward.
Create a clean passing angle before moving the puck to F1.
Immediately recognize the turnover and regain defensive position.
F2 attacks before the defense can fully reset the gap.

title: East Coast 2 on 0
description: A full-ice timing and flow drill. P1 receives a pass at the opposite blue line, turns up ice and finds P2 timing through the zone. P2 receives the pass at full speed, attacks wide and delays before finding P1 in the slot, then continues to the net for a redirect or rebound.
coaching_points: P2 waits until P1 passes the line before starting the route.
Receive the pass at full speed near the blue line.
Puck carrier attacks wide and delays long enough to create the slot pass.
After making the slot pass, continue to the net for a redirect or rebound.

title: 4 Lines Series #6
description: Four lines set up along the boards at the blue lines. Opposite players carry to the far blue line, transition backward while controlling the puck, complete a give-and-go with the line, transition forward, exchange another pass with the far line, then attack the net for a shot.
coaching_points: Keep the feet moving through both forward-to-backward and backward-to-forward transitions.
Make crisp return passes and present a clear target.
Receive each pass in motion instead of stopping the feet.
Attack the final lane with speed and release the shot by the tops of the circles.

title: Triple Give & Go - Half Ice
description: D1 carries around the net and starts a give-and-go with F1. D2 works another exchange with F2 while both forwards continue to the net. As D1 loops back into the zone, D1 exchanges one more pass with the last player in line and finishes with a high-slot shot.
coaching_points: Keep all give-and-go passes moving quickly and accurately.
Forwards continue to the net after their exchange instead of watching the puck.
D2 must stay aware of both passing options near the net.
D1 times the loop so the final return pass arrives in stride for the shot.

title: Catch and Release
description: A forward accelerates around the cone while the coach times a pass into the route. The player receives and shoots in one motion, then the opposite line repeats. The drill isolates a fast catch-and-release without extra puckhandling.
coaching_points: Accelerate around the cone so the pass arrives at game speed.
Present the stick early and receive the puck in shooting position.
Catch and release in one motion with no extra stickhandling.
Keep reps short and sharp so both shooters and goalie maintain quality.

title: Half Ice Three Lanes
description: Three players leave the same corner on different routes. One uses the outside lane, one attacks the high slot lane, and one takes the inside lane near the top of the circle. Each receives a pass from the opposite corner and finishes from a different shooting angle.
coaching_points: Keep the three routes separated so the goalie sees distinct shooting lanes.
Time the passes so players receive the puck while moving.
Use the outside, middle, and inside lanes exactly as shown in the diagram.
Finish each rep quickly and clear the net before the next group.

title: Finland Warm Up Skate 1 on 1
description: Players begin at the goal line, side-step to the wall, skate forward around the top of the circle, transition backward, then exchange passes near the bottom of the circle. They transition forward again, attack the blue line with speed, move inside-out and finish with a long shot.
coaching_points: Stay facing up ice through the footwork and transitions.
Control the puck while changing from backward to forward skating.
Make each pass while moving and immediately continue the route.
Build speed through the blue line and finish the shot without gliding.
